summary: Price County, WI tower listed as gone by FFLA under the spelling Sentinal; sources give no build, staffing or removal details.

facts.status_note: Listed as Tower Gone in the FFLA county list; no removal date or site description in the sources read.

evidence.supports: county list marks the tower gone at the listed coordinates
page gives the name as Sentinel Point and the county as Price
page heading spells the name Sentinel Point
OpenStreetMap node is named Sentinal Point Lookout Tower
OpenStreetMap node tagged as an observation tower

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLA county list and OpenStreetMap spell the name Sentinal; the Forest Lookouts page spells it Sentinel Point. The story gives both spellings and says records should be searched under both.

notes_for_editor: Very thin record. The Forest Lookouts page for this tower contains only a title and the county, so the story is short (about 110 words) because the sources hold almost nothing; it is not padded. Build date, design, staffing, owner and removal date are all absent from the sources read. Two web searches under both spellings returned nothing about this tower; results were about Fifield and Timm's Hill, which are different towers. OSM node 353894286 (45.9707826, -90.0812704, elevation 511 m) is within about 5 m of the FFLA point; the node is not verified against the structure. Page reads: about 4. Web searches: 2.
